sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:39 – 14:30)
items: Equipment: 4x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 2x Radios, 1x Ops Phone, 2x Cameras. 1x body camera charger reported missing.

Alpha Route commenced. Arrived at Victoria Street East and Queen Street headquarters check-in. Welfare checks completed at Starbucks Queen Street, Lotus Foreign Exchange, Nike, Cotton On, and Localito Convenience Store. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at McDonald’s Queen Street, Mrs Higgins, Timezone, ChaPanda, BBQ Chicken, Bobao Bar, Whimsical Blu, and Acceco Supermarket. All clear.

Welfare checks completed at Civic Theatre, Starks, 185° Sandwiches, Yes Convenience Store, Yoghurt Story, Uncle Tetsu, Luv Sushi, Burger Fuel, Daiso Japan Mart Convenience Store, and Game On. All clear.
Arrived at Skyworld Entertainment Centre and Aotea Square. Full sweep completed. All clear. Guards stood by under shelter due to heavy rain and strong winds.
Welfare checks completed at Jack’s Fried Chicken, Jack’s Cafeteria, The Terrace, and Aotea Centre. All clear.
Walkthrough completed through Bledisloe building alleyway. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Elliott Stables, Elliott Street Apartments, Atrium on Elliott, and Elliott food court. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Pizza Club Elliott Street, Domino’s Pizza, Tandoor, Ground Coffee, Hikoco, Wilson Carpark food stalls, and Freshmarket Store. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Woolworths Victoria Street West, Kiwi Gift, Mr Katsu, City Liquor, Cinnamon Squared, Fern, Lord Nelson’s Steak House, and Scrunchy Millers. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Sky Mart Convenience Store, Formery, Little Albert’s Coffee, Barclay Suites, Bespoke Coffee, Good To Go Supermarket, and Natural Health Souvenirs. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at SVS Vape Shop, SCS Convenience Store, Taco Infusion Mexican Cuisine, Galatata Kebab and Grill, Bistro Saine, Sumo Sushi, and Shakespeare Tavern. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Albert Mart Convenience Store, Discount Dairy and Vape Shop, Nola Coffee, and Ichiiban Japanese Restaurant. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Zibetto Espresso Bar, Palmer Bar, Ronnie’s Cafe, Woolworths Lower Albert Street, and Aotea Gifts. All clear.
Arrived at Commercial Bay. Full sweep completed. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at McDonald’s Britomart, Starbucks, Hollywood Cafe, Daily Bread, Deli & Bakery, Four Square, Adidas, and Movenpick Hotel. All clear.
Security presence maintained before moving to next checkpoint.
Team 2 dispatched to the top of the CBD.
Alpha Route ended. Delta Route commenced.
Arrived at Commercial Bay. Full sweep completed. All clear.
Welfare check and sweep completed through Fort Lane. All clear.
Arrived at Fort Street and Fort Lane. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Evans Kebab, Vape Haven, Right Track Sports Bar, Murdoch’s, Seoul Night, KFC, Vapor King, and Jo & Joe. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Hoka, UGG, North Face, Taco Bell, and Shortland Street Convenience Store. All clear.

Welfare checks completed on lower High Street towards Shortland Street — Barkers, 3 Wise Men, Corner Bar, Debrett’s Kitchen, Hotel DeBrett, Cosmic, Trainers, Mortimer Hirst Optometrist, Gorman, Melba, High Street Supermarket, Shut The Front Door, Books on High, Little Unity Books, Aimai, Vapo, and Optics. All clear.

Welfare checks completed at Coco Lane, Aesop, Tatty’s, Daikoku Cosmetic, AS Colour, Sushi Pac, Coffee Club, Chubby Boy, Dong De Moon, Machi Machi, Vape Factory, Loaded, Sushi and Coffee, Havana House, Lavish, A-Z, Coco Fresh Fruit and Tea, Coconut Factory, and Brand Warehouse. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Cosmetic Retailer, Look Sharp, and Farmers. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Glassons, Peter Alexander, Lotus Foreign Exchange, and Vans. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Durham Street East alleyway and surrounding businesses. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Merchant, Novo, Lovisa, TechPro, Fat Salmon Sushi, and Canterbury Arcade stores. All clear.
Guards returned to headquarters to dry jackets due to heavy rain.
Guards stood by at headquarters and charged Ops phone, which was at 15%.
Patrols resumed with Ops phone at 40%. Route sector exchange completed with Team 2.
Welfare checks completed at Starbucks, Lotus, Nike, Daily Drip, Localito Convenience Store, Footlocker, Cosmetic Clinic, Bag Planet, Mobile Planet, and Darby Street stores. All clear.

Welfare checks completed at Strand Arcade, Ippondo, Sale Shop, Fun Tech, Cue City Pool Table, Ava Chi, Mid City Shopping Centre, 77 Convenience Store, Unichem Pharmacy, McDonald’s Queen Street, Mrs Higgins, Timezone, ChaPanda, BBQ Village, Acceco, Sal’s Pizza, NZ Muscle, Remedy Coffee, Yoghurt Story, Yes 24 Convenience Store, Daiso Japan, Burger Fuel, and Game On. All clear.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Full scope of the location completed. No issues. Guards stood by for response calls.
Arrived at top of Mayoral Drive. Area checked. No issues found.
Welfare check completed at Queens Food Court. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Munster Inn and Nando’s. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Auckland Library. All clear.
Arrived at Lorne Street and Wellesley Street. No issues found.
Response call from Movenpick Hotel regarding a male being a nuisance inside the lobby and refusing to leave. Team 2 notified and dispatched.
Arrived at Elliott Street Apartments. No issues. Movenpick called back advising the male vagrant had left; response could be cancelled. Team 2 still advised to complete a welfare check.
Welfare check completed through the Atrium on Elliott food court while heading towards Crowne Plaza Hotel.
Welfare checks completed at City Convenience Store, Mr Barber, and AA Insurance. All clear.
Arrived at top of Victoria Street. Welfare checks completed. All clear. Patrol continued back down Victoria Street.
Welfare checks completed at Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse Victoria Street. All clear.
Returned to headquarters for lunch break and afternoon shift changeover preparation.
Response call from Typo regarding a male inside the store who appeared under the influence of drugs or alcohol and was unable to keep balance.
Arrived at Typo. Auckland Council were already present with the POI outside. Guards asked him to sit at the bus stop to rest and advised him not to return to the store. POI was compliant.

Typo called back after Auckland Council told them to call HOTC again. Staff advised guards could not act further if the POI was not causing issues, and Council should call an ambulance if medical assistance was required.

sections.title: Day Shift — Team 2 (09:30 – 17:00)
items: Brief phone meeting with Team 1 completed. Nothing specific to look out for. Team 2 commenced patrol up Queen Street.
Welfare checks on upper Queen Street completed. No issues reported by local stores.
Welfare checks around Aotea Square completed. All clear. Patrol continued.
Welfare sweep along Lorne Street completed. All clear. Proceeded towards Victoria Street.
Welfare sweeps completed on Victoria Street and Federal Street. Proceeded towards the Cathedral.
Welfare sweep completed at the Cathedral. No issues reported.
Complete sweep up Queen Street completed. All clear. Maintained presence around upper Queen Street.
Welfare check completed at Auckland Library. All clear. Security presence resumed on Queen Street.
No response calls to report. Returned to headquarters for route changeover.
Route changeover completed with Team 1. Team 2 proceeded down Queen Street.
Full sweep around lower Queen Street completed. Patrol continued towards Commercial Bay.
Response call from Movenpick requesting assistance removing an individual refusing to leave. Team proceeded towards the location.
Call back from Movenpick requesting stand-down as the POI had already left the premises.
Full sweep completed around Commercial Bay. Returned to headquarters for toilet break and to charge personal phone for reports.
Debrief with Team 1 and route changeover completed. No issues. Commenced patrol up Queen Street.
Team 2 stood down. No further issues to report.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:35 – 22:30)
items: Equipment handover: 4x Body Vests, 1x Ops Phone, 2x Keycards, 4x Sets of Keys, 1x Phone Charger.
Afternoon shift commenced patrols up Queen Street. Welfare checks completed on stores between Victoria Street East and Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Welfare checks completed. All clear.
Aotea Square sweep completed. All clear. Security presence maintained.
Arrived at Mayoral Drive. Welfare check completed with Te Waihorotiu train station guard. All clear.
Arrived at top of Victoria Street. Welfare checks completed at 77 Convenience Store, Amelia’s Cafe, Mr Tacos, V Phix Mobiles, Subway, Coffee Club, and The Fiddler. All clear.
Arrived at bottom of Victoria Street West. Welfare checks completed at Sky Mart, Scrunchy Millers, City Liquor, Belgar Barbershop, Woolworths, Chemist Warehouse, Mecca, and AA Insurance. All clear.
Arrived at Lorne Street and commenced full sweep towards Auckland Library.
Arrived at Auckland Library. Full sweep of Lorne Street and welfare checks completed. All clear. Guards took cover due to weather.
Arrived outside Ava Chi Chicken. Security presence maintained while monitoring for issues or vagrants.
Response call from Celine’s Darby Street regarding vagrants sitting outside the entrance.
Arrived at Celine’s. Male vagrants advised to move along; they complied. Security presence maintained.
Guards took cover due to weather conditions.
Response call from Ippondo Queen Street regarding a female sitting outside the store playing loud music.
Arrived at Ippondo. Female advised to move along; she complied. Security presence maintained.
Response call from Ian at Queens Arcade regarding a male inside the building who appeared under the influence of illegal substances.
Arrived at Queens Arcade. Male had already departed. Guards stood by in case he returned.
Response call from manager Nikki regarding suspicious people inside Wilson Carpark on Wyndham Street.
Arrived at Wilson Carpark. Suspicious group of vagrants were departing. Guards stood by.
Arrived at Queen Street and lower Wyndham Street. Welfare checks completed. All clear.
Response call from Canterbury Arcade regarding a male inside the lobby who appeared under the influence of illegal substances. Assistance requested to remove him.
Arrived at Canterbury Arcade. Guards advised the male to leave; he complied.
Response call from 102 Albert Street regarding a male being aggressive towards clients of Surf n Turf Backpackers.
Arrived at Surf n Turf Backpackers. Guards advised the male to move along. He complied but was verbally abusive towards guards. Security presence maintained in case he returned.
Returned to headquarters for floor checks.
Floor checks completed. Guards stood by charging Ops phone at 9%.
Echo Route commenced. Arrived at Darby Street check-in. Welfare checks completed at Celine’s, Mali Thai, Pizza Club, Domino’s, and Tandoori. All clear.
Arrived at top of Victoria Street. Welfare checks completed at 77 Convenience Store and The Fiddler. All clear.
Arrived at Wyndham Street check-in. Welfare check completed at Ace Karaoke. All clear.
Arrived at bottom of Wyndham Street. Welfare checks completed at Chemist Warehouse, QF Tavern, and Ibis Budget Hotel. All clear.
Arrived at Commercial Bay. Welfare check completed at McDonald’s Britomart. All clear.
Commercial Bay sweep completed. All clear.
Arrived at Fort Street check-in. Jo & Joe requested assistance moving along a male drinking outside the premises and vaping inside the building.
Guards advised the male to move along; he complied. Bodycam footage captured. Security presence maintained.
Arrived at Freyberg Square and Chancery Square.
Chancery Square and Freyberg Square sweep completed. All clear. Echo Route ended.
Arrived at Lorne Street and Victoria Street East.
Arrived at Auckland Library. Full sweep completed from Lorne Street, including welfare checks on stores. All clear.
Aotea Square sweep completed. All clear. Security presence maintained.
Arrived at Elliott Street and Wellesley Street. Welfare check completed at Elliott Stables. All clear.
Arrived at headquarters and commenced 30-minute break.
Afternoon shift completed. Handover to night shift completed.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:40 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 4x Keys, 2x Body Cameras, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 1x Ops Phone.
Check-in completed at Chemist Warehouse / Kathmandu. No issues.
Commercial Bay patrol commenced. Full sweep underway.
Commercial Bay full sweep completed. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Albert Street Convenience Store. No issues.
Bar101 checked. No issues. Returned to headquarters for floor checks.
Aotea Square patrol commenced. Full sweep underway.
Aotea Square full sweep completed. All clear.
McDonald’s Queen Street checked. No issues.
Full sweep completed at Freyberg Square, Chancery Square, and Kitchener Street. All clear.
Full sweep completed at Fort Street and Wilson Carpark. All clear.
Response call from McDonald’s Queen Street regarding an individual sleeping inside.
Arrived at McDonald’s Queen Street. Male individual was sleeping inside; asked to leave. He stated he was going to buy food and did so. Manager requested guards remain on standby.
Male was calm and eating. Manager advised all was okay and asked the male not to sleep inside again. No further issues.
Albert Street Convenience Store checked. No issues.
Full sweep of Victoria Street completed.
Corner of Lorne Street and Wakefield Street checked. All clear.
McDonald’s Queen Street checked. No issues.
Guards left headquarters and resumed patrol.
St Patrick’s Cathedral checked. All clear.
Full sweep of Wyndham Street completed. All clear.
McDonald’s Britomart and Commercial Bay checked. All clear.
Fort Street and Wilson Carpark checked. All clear.
Freyberg Square and Chancery Square checked. All clear.
Corner of Lorne Street and Wakefield Street checked. No issues.
Elliott Street and Wilson Carpark checked. All clear.
